purpose: Machine-readable Trigger-2 lineage/status registry so stale, leaky, superseded, retrofit-required, component-only, and pending-review artifacts cannot silently re-enter the final training mix.
global_rules: No artifact is training-eligible merely because it is newest.
Training eligibility requires exact-current source identity, required gates, family/provenance split isolation, and canonical dataset admission.
All pre-semantic-Hyperposition integrated Trigger-2 families are re-audit-required before mixed-corpus admission.
Synthetic task-world resolution is not canonical/world evidence.
Qwen3/Qwen3.5 model-family or checkpoint ancestry does not transfer J-Space causal labels.
A deterministic reproducible generator may still leak labels; nuisance independence is a separate property.
Flat component drills may remain useful as COMPONENT_ONLY but cannot define the integrated Xeno/EntityOS-HCU operating frame.
FREE_ONLY: no paid training/provider execution is authorized by this registry.

external_research_delta.source: Wu, Geiger & Millière, How Do Transformers Learn Variable Binding in Symbolic Programs?, arXiv:2505.20896
external_research_delta.finding: Training can pass through an early shallow heuristic phase before a systematic binding mechanism emerges.
external_research_delta.training_implication: Do not evaluate binder training only at the final checkpoint. Add frozen intermediate mechanism-transition checkpoints with heuristic baselines so shortcut-to-systematic transition can be observed instead of hidden.

external_research_delta.source: Braun et al., Understanding (Un)Reliability of Steering Vectors in Language Models, arXiv:2505.22637
external_research_delta.finding: Steering reliability varies strongly across samples/prompts and improves when activation-difference directions are coherent and separable.
external_research_delta.training_implication: J-Space/steering acceptance remains model- and prompt-family-specific; require direction-coherence/separability plus matched random/orthogonal controls rather than a single global vector claim.

external_research_delta.source: Sankaranarayanan et al., Surgical Activation Steering via Generative Causal Mediation, arXiv:2602.16080
external_research_delta.finding: Causal mediation-based component selection can outperform correlational probe baselines for steering.
external_research_delta.training_implication: Where model internals are accessible, promotion should prefer intervention/mediation evidence over decodability alone; probes remain measurements, not causal proof.

external_research_delta.source: Chen et al., On-Policy Replay for Continual Supervised Fine-Tuning, arXiv:2605.29495
external_research_delta.finding: On-policy replay reduces forgetting across tested 7-8B backbones.
external_research_delta.training_implication: For later multi-stage specialization, on-policy retention replay is a research candidate, but it is not assumed to transfer to Qwen3.5-0.8B without a zero-cost ablation.

new_required_training_gates.rule: Freeze intermediate checkpoints before training, score intended task plus heuristic baselines (position, lexical/template, codebook frequency/order, nuisance-only exact-signature/learner). A final high score is insufficient if shortcut baselines remain predictive.

Linear decodability may nominate a feature. Promotion to causal control requires a preregistered intervention with matched random/orthogonal/shuffle/lesion/rescue controls at exact model/runtime identity.
